A few stone steps curve away at left, two small herb pots near wall. No distant harbor or full street yet. We now see lower house wall and little roof/eave segment, not an entire shop building. ART STYLE: match reference's atmospheric detailed pixel-painted irregular color clusters and stepped broken edges. Warm amber lighting on stonework and fur tips, subdued blue-violet shadows, cream parchment outside. Not smooth watercolor, clean-lined anime, vector, toy render, 3D diorama or crisp mascot. Keep focused calm lofi emotional tone. All new objects same pixel material as cat and ground.
No extra people/animals, human hands or skin, readable text, labels/UI, title/rank numeral, border or watermark. One still concept, no motion arrows or multiple frames.
